text: chapter: Send to Me agent button
What is the todo payload (title, notes, linked card/subject), and where should the button live (web, iPhone, extension, or chat)? None of this is specified.
How would post-anki authenticate to the Me agent, and is sending user content to that outside system acceptable (privacy, data shared between apps)? This needs a stakeholder decision.

The Me agent exposes no documented network-reachable write interface for receiving a todo. It is unknown whether it would offer a networked MCP with a write tool, an HTTP endpoint (such as the capture server or inbox), or something else. The Me agent repo is outside this codebase, so this needs a stakeholder answer.
